killedBy: firstAppearanceFor (issue #777) orders by position in the level list, never by the level id
why: Level ids are opaque and order comes only from position (campaign-types.ts). Today's ids happen to be level-01 to level-05 in order, so reading the number out of the id gives the same answers on the shipped campaign and survives everything but a campaign whose ids and positions disagree, which is exactly what #360's reorder will produce.
